CustomField.description: True while the ContentPublication circuit breaker (design §6.5) is tripped. AttachmentPersistQueueable and AttachmentCarrierSweepBatch skip all ContentVersion DML while this is true and record a "suspended until" note instead of attempting a publish. Set only by AttachmentPersistFinalizer.trip(), on a message-substring match against 'ContentPublication Limit exceeded' — never on a type check, since the platform wraps the original exception as System.AsyncException.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Clears automatically once now() passes Suspended_Until_DateTime__c, or can be cleared manually in Setup to resume persistence early.
CustomField.label: Is Suspended
